title: Ask for Any Appliance: A Prompt-Programmable Foundation Model for Non-Intrusive Load Monitoring
abstract: arXiv:2609.23146v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Non-intrusive load monitoring (NILM) estimates appliance-level consumption from a whole-home meter, but appliance-specific models and fixed output inventories make coverage costly to extend. We present FM4NILM (Foundation Model for NILM), a single prompt-programmable model that estimates a requested appliance's power trajectory from aggregate measurements, a natural-language description, and optional activation exemplars. A lightweight cadence-aware transformer is pretrained by masked reconstruction on 645k sequences from seven public corpora spanning 1-60 s sampling intervals, then aligned with appliance requests using observation-masked losses for partially labeled households. A Bernoulli-lognormal decoder separates activity detection from conditional power estimation. On held-out households and time periods from REDD, UK-DALE, and REFIT, one frozen text-prompted model serves twelve appliance-corpus requests, achieving 0.556 event F1,

translated_title: 询问任意电器：一个用于非侵入式负荷监测的提示可编程基础模型
translated_abstract: 非侵入式负荷监测（NILM）从全屋电表数据估计电器级别的用电量，但针对特定电器的模型和固定的输出清单使得扩展覆盖范围成本高昂。我们提出了FM4NILM（NILM基础模型），这是一个单一的提示可编程模型，能够根据总用电测量数据、自然语言描述以及可选的电器激活示例，估计所请求电器的功率轨迹。一个轻量级的节奏感知Transformer在来自七个公共语料库、涵盖1-60秒采样间隔的64.5万个序列上通过掩码重建进行预训练，然后使用观察掩码损失在部分标注的家庭数据上与电器请求进行对齐。伯努利-对数正态解码器将活动检测与条件功率估计分离。在REDD、UK-DALE和REFIT的留出家庭和时间段上，一个冻结的文本提示模型即可服务于十二个电器-语料库请求，实现了0.556的事件F1……
tldr: 提出了首个面向非侵入式负荷监测的提示可编程基础模型FM4NILM，仅凭一个冻结模型即可通过自然语言提示和激活示例估计任意请求电器的功率轨迹，大幅降低了扩展电器覆盖范围的成本。
en_tdlr: FM4NILM is a prompt-programmable foundation model for NILM that estimates any requested appliance's power trajectory from aggregate readings, natural-language descriptions, and optional activation exemplars, with a single frozen model serving twelve appliance-corpus requests.
